title: Partner With Ronnie Care
subtitle: We collaborate with institutional grantmakers, corporate CSR initiatives, INGOs, and government ministries to scale clinical outreach and sustainable WASH systems across West Africa.

pillars.title: Corporate CSR Alignment
pillars.description: Tailored ESG and CSR impact programs delivering measurable water and healthcare indicators for corporate stakeholders.

pillars.title: Institutional Grants & INGOs
pillars.description: Proven financial stewardship and field implementation capacity for USAID, EU, and foundation-backed public health grants.
